name: Pheasant
lateFeature: Long barred tail shafts, enamel-like neck scales and intricate white-edged mantle feathers
anatomyNotes: Right-facing male Pheasant is a horizontal long-tailed composition, not a round songbird. Tail occupies more than half the artwork and contains two narrow divergent feather blades with paper between them. Early gestures should establish that reach; later strokes track the bars and feather shafts. White neck ring and red face retain species identity.
